explication: Stirling PDF is an open-source PDF editing platform for browser, desktop, and self-hosted use. Its principal workflow is submitting documents to a PDF tool or pipeline and receiving processed files; the sampled pipeline controller shows input preparation, pipeline execution, and single-file or ZIP responses. The README also documents editing, signing, redaction, conversion, OCR, REST APIs, and no-code workflows. Several of those capabilities are represented at directory level because their implementation was not sampled; those relationships are documented rather than inferred from imports.
